description:
Re-derive a single stale or expired segment from the current IAG. Updates ONLY the segment — referencing audiences are never touched; the response lists them in affected_audiences so you can recount or refresh them (use refresh_audience for a whole-composition refresh). Behaviour is subtype-specific:
- filter: synchronous — bumps current_version, nulls record_count, resets the 90-day TTL, returns status: active. If the segment is already fresh the call is a no-op (refreshed: false); pass force: true to bump anyway. Call count_segment afterwards for a fresh count.
- matched: with hitl false/unset (default): returns status: pending + upload_url (24 h presign) targeting the canonical upload path — or upload_urls (an array) when shard_count > 1 — instruct the user to re-upload their identity list (one same-format file per URL for a sharded upload; every CSV shard needs its own header); identity resolution runs automatically once all shards are uploaded. Then call wait_for_segment(segment_id). With hitl: true: the upload is staged instead — after upload, follow the analyze_audience_upload -> confirm_column_mappings / cancel_matched_upload -> wait_for_segment sequence documented on create_segment(subtype=matched). Returns 409 SHARED_SOURCE_DATA for matched duplicates that reference another segment's data — the message names the source segment to refresh instead.
- custom: immutable snapshot; returns 409 CUSTOM_REGENERATION_REQUIRED. Request a new internal data-team publication.
Returns 409 SEGMENT_ARCHIVED for archived segments — restore them first with archive_segment(restore=true). Async build completion or failure may notify configured external webhooks and opted-in users by email. Requires 'creator' scope.

force.description: Filter subtype only: bump the version even when the segment already looks fresh. Defaults to false.

hitl.description: If true: stages a matched segment's re-upload instead of resolving automatically. Defaults to false.

shard_count.description: Matched subtype: set > 1 for multiple same-format shards.

name: refresh_segment

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

filter_groups.description: Complete saved filter definition; one AND group also represents a simple flat filter list

combinator.description: Join to the preceding included group; ignored for the first group. AND binds before OR. Exclusion groups always subtract.

field.description: field_name from get_field_catalog; ZIP5 also accepts zip, zip_code or postal_code. Use published operators and enum_values

text_comparison.description: STRING =, !=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE and ARRAY<STRING> ARRAY_CONTAINS, ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY. Default exact. case_insensitive applies Unicode case folding to stored text and the supplied value; use when capitalization is incidental.

trim_whitespace.description: Supported STRING or ARRAY<STRING> comparisons only. Trim leading/trailing whitespace on both sides; default false.

value.description: Scalar for comparisons; array for IN/NOT IN; ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY matches any listed value; [lower, upper] inclusive for BETWEEN; LIKE uses % for any sequence and _ for one character; omit for IS NULL/IS NOT NULL. Use enum_values codes, not display labels

id.description: Caller-chosen group ID, for example geography; prefix _exclude:: to subtract this group

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

record_count.description: Stored count; null means unknown. Call count_segment for a current count.

record_limit.description: Maximum members; null means no explicit cap

title: Refresh Segment
